extras: Requires specific OSS region knowledge and has a hard cutoff date (March 20, 2025) regarding public endpoints. Provides specific workflow advice for PDF annotation.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that automatically uploads attachments (images, videos, audio, PDFs) to Aliyun OSS, stores them as permanent oss:// references, and renders them with dynamically signed URLs.
problem: Addresses challenges related to syncing and sharing large media files across multiple devices by moving them to cloud storage.
summary: Automatically uploads media files (images, audio, video, PDFs) to Aliyun OSS, storing permanent oss:// references and rendering them with dynamically signed URLs.
